restoration_note: Teaching describes the four contests of regeneration as the Lord meets the self successively: First Man (love breaks the claim, cuts down the bitter tree), Living Spirit (operative power binds the archons in three strongholds), Third Ambassador (the call exposes the self's counterfeit wealth/luxury), Jesus the Glorious (illumining truth strips and re-establishes the structure, crowns regeneration with hope of Adam through Call-and-Answer). Editor's proposals are mostly accepted as well-grounded; the formulaic war-headings ('The Nth war is that of the…') constrain section-openings strongly. The closing section (after war 4's exposition) is heavily lacunose: many fills there are marked low/unrestorable, since only fragments survive of what appears to be a doxological/closing passage about the elect, the kingdom of darkness undone, and the King who raises.
